  report: null
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE, error=FALSE)
r <- params$report
show <- function(x, empty) if (nrow(x)) cat(knitr::kable(x, format='html', escape=TRUE)) else cat(paste0('<p>', empty, '</p>'))
```

This is a **curated DuckDB snapshot**, assembled at render time. It does not search the full program corpus or query live EMMA. Relations retain their recorded direction and status. Missing rows mean only that the selected path is not present in this prototype.

## Selected starting point

```{r start, results='asis'}
cat('<p>Starting type: <strong>', htmltools::htmlEscape(r$start_type), '</strong>.</p>')
show(r$start, 'No starting record.')
```

## Studies and surveys

For a survey start, only its linked study version is followed. Question and project starts follow all linked study versions in the fixture; version-selection policy needs future review. Study-level associations do not establish that a finding is attributable to a particular event.

```{r studies, results='asis'}
show(r$studies, 'No study version is linked to this starting point.')
show(r$events, 'No survey event is linked to the selected study versions.')
```

## Research questions and hypotheses

The question–study association may be later proposed relevance, not the original purpose of the study. A hypothesis reached through a question is not thereby established as a study hypothesis.

```{r questions, results='asis'}
show(r$questions, 'No research question is linked to the selected study versions.')
show(r$hypotheses, 'No hypothesis is linked through those questions.')
```

## Project context

Project links include their relation type, status and scope. A UMRRDB project reference is not automatically an EMMA identity or a survey-to-GIS-feature match.

```{r projects, results='asis'}
show(r$projects, 'No project reference is linked to the selected study versions.')
```

## Historical project objectives

From a project start these objectives follow its direct recorded associations. From a question or survey they are reached through the study-to-project and project-to-objective associations shown in the table. These are candidate cross-system links; the historical source does not establish an EMMA identity or entry.

```{r objectives, results='asis'}
show(r$objectives, 'No objective is linked along this path in the prototype.')
```

## Reported findings and assessments

Findings are linked at the study-version level. Their source locator and source-version hash are retained where recorded; no raw observations or monitoring task are inferred. Multiple source passages can produce multiple rows.

```{r findings, results='asis'}
show(r$findings, 'No findings are linked to the selected study versions.')
if (r$include_hypothetical) cat('<p><strong>Hypothetical examples are enabled.</strong> They are not practitioner-authored assessments or decisions.</p>')
show(r$assessments, 'No assessment is shown; hypothetical examples are excluded by default.')
```

## Candidate Restoration Features

The following are feature records whose exported project number matches the candidate UMRRDB project reference. This is a **candidate project-level match**, not a verified survey-to-segment relationship, exposure or effect. No map or spatial analysis is implied. The source snapshot identifies the exported feature class and its hash.

```{r features, results='asis'}
if (r$feature_source == 'geopackage') cat('<p>Source: full imported GeoPackage Revetment layer. Geometry presence is reported without asserting a spatial relationship.</p>')
if (r$feature_source == 'legacy_xml') cat('<p>Source: legacy XML attribute fixture; its geometry was not imported.</p>')
if (is.null(r$features)) cat('<p>The optional Restoration Features snapshot is not present in this database.</p>') else show(r$features, 'No matching feature records were found in this source snapshot; this does not establish absence elsewhere.')
```

The [Bertom source review](https://github.com/MVR-GIS/restorationmonitoring/blob/main/dev/goals/bertom-rock-habitat-linkage-review.md) and earlier [multi-entry prototype](https://github.com/MVR-GIS/restorationmonitoring/blob/main/dev/features/bertom-multi-entry-prototype.md) preserve additional source-backed and candidate relationships.

## Snapshot provenance

```{r provenance, results='asis'}
show(data.frame(Item=c('Generated (UTC)','Database MD5 at read','DuckDB R package'), Value=c(r$generated_at,r$database_md5,r$duckdb_version)), 'No provenance.')
```
